description: This file contains shell script functions for checking image formats and performing upgrades on devices using the Redboot FIS (Flash Image System). It includes functions to validate the image and to upgrade the firmware based on specific conditions.

methods.name: platform_check_image_redboot_fis
methods.description: Checks if the provided image has the correct magic word for Redboot FIS images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_redboot_fis
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by extracting kernel and root filesystem from sysupgrade file and writing with 'mtd' based on specific conditions.
